implementation_state: Persistence and ownership exist: AppState owns an AccountStore behind the optional account feature, and the registry is configuration on ProviderConfig. Execution now exists too, as account::reconcile, which probes declared accounts through a dyn shim and publishes into the store — including on failure, so a stale healthy reading cannot masquerade as current. The node stays PARTIAL because execution is not yet integrated: no call site invokes the reconciler, and no credential-resolution path feeds it. The record previously claimed persistence and ownership did not exist; it corrected the record, not the code. See E-119.
required_gates: Generic account types and pure calculations
unblock_condition: Revalidate Stage 5 and add an owned persistence/runtime contract without changing ML feature order.
